name: Add contacts to a list
description: Add one or more existing contacts to one or more lists. Asynchronous: success means the job was queued, so confirm with contacts.get_lists (count) before reporting it done. The same endpoint runs other bulk actions; only ADD_TO_LIST was verified.

is_all_selected.description: true applies to every contact matching fe_query instead of ids. Not tested.

execution.auth: Cookie session of the logged-in app.brevo.com user, sent with the request (fetch credentials: include). No API key. Replayed from inside the app page only; behavior from outside a browser (CSRF, CORS, session expiry) was not tested.

verification.notes: Executed through the UI with request capture. Added contact 2 to list 5 from the Contacts page bulk action; list count went from 0 to 1.

side_effects: Queues a background job; the list count updated within a few seconds in testing.

errors.when: action is not a known bulk action
errors.agent_should: Use ADD_TO_LIST. The endpoint does not list valid values.

alternative_executions.auth: API key in the api-key header. Not included here.
